about: Renders a card a person checks and unchecks, with a title, a description, a box and an optional addon row. A press anywhere on the card toggles it, and a horizontal fieldset lays several cards in rows of equal height.

agreement.about: A required card in a field. Press Continue with the card unchecked: the field turns invalid and shows its error text, and the card's edge turns red, until the card is checked.
agreement.title: In a field

align.about: The words at the start of the card, or centred.
align.title: Alignment

email.about: A summary every morning at eight.
email.title: Email

push.about: An alert on this device as it happens.
push.title: Push

sms.about: A text for failed payouts only.
sms.title: Text message

dpa.about: We process payout data on your behalf under its terms.
dpa.title: Data processing agreement

extras.about: Cards stacked in a phone's width, each with a price in its addon. Single sign-on is disabled, because it needs the Enterprise plan. The input of each card lists its description and its addon in `aria-describedby`.
extras.title: Addons

layout.about: The box at the end of the words, or above them.
layout.title: Layout

audit.about: Every change to a payout, kept for a year.
audit.title: Audit log

sso.about: Sign in through your identity provider.
sso.title: Single sign-on

support.about: A reply within four working hours.
support.title: Priority support

palette.about: Every palette on the outline look. The palette sets the checked card's edge and the box's fill.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: The padding, the gaps, the box and the words step together.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: Invalid, read-only and disabled cards. A read-only card shows its state and ignores presses. A disabled card fills with the subtle surface.
states.title: States

title: Checkbox card

variant.about: Every look with Email checked. `solid` fills the checked card, `subtle` deepens a muted card, `surface` tints the checked card and `outline` sets its edge.
variant.title: Looks
